sections.html:
Look for West Jordan where the Salt Lake Valley ends in the southwest corner of Salt Lake County. The Jordan River marks its eastern line, and the Oquirrh range stands along the west. South Jordan is the neighbor to the south, Taylorsville and Kearns sit north, and Sandy, Murray and Midvale lie across the river.

Residents numbered 116,961 in 2020, third highest among Utah cities, and the latest estimate is 116,812. Growth has flattened after a run from 68,336 in 2000 to 103,712 in 2010. With 27,192 people in 1980 and 42,892 in 1990, most of the housing stock dates from after 1980. The city counted 36,247 housing units in 2020, 3.3% of them vacant.

The ground tilts as you go west. Welby, Copper Hills and Jordan Hills sit on the lower Oquirrh slopes, with views and drainage that the flat blocks by the river do not share.

sections.h2: Roads and rail near your house
sections.html:
West Jordan has freeway and rail access on its edges and a few major arterials through the middle. Interstate 15 hugs the city's eastern edge and Interstate 215 angles in from the northeast. Bangerter Highway cuts through the center, with Redwood Road carrying traffic on the east side.

The Mountain View Corridor is a ten-lane route with exits at 7800 South, 9000 South and Old Bingham Highway. A TRAX light rail line has six stops in West Jordan on its way from Fashion Place West in Murray to Daybreak in South Jordan.

Shoppers measure the trip to a rail stop or an on-ramp almost at once. Noise can follow a house beside Bangerter or Redwood, but a short walk to a platform attracts commuters.

sections.h2: Which school district is your house in?
sections.html:
Jordan School District covers most of West Jordan, while Granite School District takes two small northern pieces. The city's two high schools are West Jordan High School and Copper Hills High School.

Houses along a district line can feed different schools even across the street from each other. Get the boundary for your address in writing from the district before you advertise, since families ask.

A West Jordan landlord holds a General Business License and files a Rental Dwelling application. Owners can join the Good Landlord Program, which is voluntary and discounts the fee for those who take a four-hour class and keep a signed agreement, a written lease and tenant applications on file. The class repeats every four years.

Each rental unit should come with at least one off-street parking space at no extra charge. Code enforcement works from 8000 S. Redwood Road at 801-569-5000, and neighbors can report problems on the city's online Report a Problem form.

Landlords should renew a lapsed license before putting the house on the market.

Weather records from Salt Lake City, the closest long-term station, put the January high at 38.6 degrees and the low at 24.2. In July the high is 94.0 and the low 68.2. A year brings roughly 15.5 inches of precipitation and about 52 inches of snow, and winter inversions hold air in the valley.

A house's earthquake exposure depends on local hazards and on the year it was built, which is why buyers ask about the foundation and any retrofits. Inspectors tend to go through three items:

  • Roof age, since snow and summer sun both wear shingles.
  • Furnace and air conditioner age.
  • Foundation cracks and drainage on hillside lots in Copper Hills and Jordan Hills.

sections.h2: Property tax and the tax calendar
sections.html:
Salt Lake County asks for property tax by November 30, and any balance left on December 1 is delinquent. Notices of valuation are mailed by July 22 and tax notices by November 1. Owners who disagree with a value take it to the Board of Equalization between August 1 and September 15. Values reflect the property as of January 1.

Your primary residence earns a 45% exemption on up to one acre, which leaves 55% of market value to tax. A second home or an empty residential property pays on 100%.

Take a deed to the Salt Lake County Recorder at 2001 South State Street, Suite N1-600, any weekday between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. A recording costs a flat $40.00, with $2.00 added for each legal description past ten.

A recordable deed lists the parcel number and the buyer's mailing address and carries a notary acknowledgment. Title companies usually draft and file it on your behalf.

sections.h2: What to do before you list
sections.html:
Walk the house with a pen in hand. Note the age of the roof, the furnace and the air conditioner, and look for foundation cracks and drainage trouble, especially on a hillside lot. Gather the deed, the latest tax notice and any receipts for past repairs. Check the parcel number on the notice so every document refers to the same property.

If the walk turns up more work than you want to take on, a direct sale may cost you less time than fixing everything first.

sections.h2: Ways to sell a West Jordan house
sections.html:
Owners here choose among listing, selling alone and taking a cash offer, and the house's condition plus your calendar should settle it. Listing works for a house in good repair that you can show over several weeks. A direct sale fits deferred repairs, a tenant in place, a mortgage running late or an estate to wrap up.

Cash Home Buyers purchases West Jordan houses, and houses across Utah, in whatever shape they are in. We walk you through how the number was reached. No clock is running on your answer.

sections.h2: Selling a rental or an inherited house
sections.html:
Two cases come up often. A landlord who wants out should confirm that the business license and rental dwelling registration are current, settle any open complaint with code enforcement, and arrange access with the tenant before anyone tours the house. An heir who lives elsewhere should ask a title company which papers prove the right to sign, since the Recorder needs a deed with a notary acknowledgment.

Either way, start by asking the County Treasurer for the tax balance. Whatever is owed is paid out of the sale proceeds at closing, so it should not stall the deal.

The closing itself is routine. The title company confirms the payoff, prorates the year's tax, records the deed and sends you the proceeds.

faqs.q: What county is West Jordan, UT in?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County. Tax notices, appeals and deed recording all go through county offices in Salt Lake City.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in West Jordan?
faqs.a: November 30, with delinquency starting December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1 each year.

faqs.q: Does West Jordan require a rental license?
faqs.a: Yes. Landlords need a General Business License and a Rental Dwelling application. The Good Landlord Program is optional and gives a discounted fee to owners who finish the class.

faqs.q: Which school district is West Jordan in?
faqs.a: Most of the city is in the Jordan School District. Two small northern sections are in the Granite School District.

faqs.q: Can I sell my West Jordan house without repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. No law makes you repair a house before you sell it. A cash buyer purchases it as it stands, and you can decide after you see an offer.
